question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the word: **Salubrious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **2) Wholesome**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Salubrious"** means something that is health-giving, beneficial, or promoting well-being. (स्वास्थ्यकर)
 
 
• **Example:** The salubrious climate of the hill station attracted many tourists who wanted to escape the polluted city air.
 
 
• The correct word **"Wholesome"** also means conducive to health or well-being, and is often used to describe something beneficial or good for physical or mental health. (पौष्टिक/स्वास्थ्यप्रद)
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor recommended a wholesome diet consisting of fresh fruits and vegetables for better health.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Wholesome**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unhealthy** (अस्वास्थ्यकर): Something that is harmful to health or not conducive to well-being.
 
 
• **Example:** Eating junk food regularly can lead to an unhealthy lifestyle.
 
 
 
• **Harmful** (हानिकारक): Something that causes damage or injury to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking is harmful to both the smoker and those around them.
 
 
 
• **Detrimental** (हानिकारक): Something that has a negative or damaging effect on something else.
 
 
• **Example:** The factory's emissions are detrimental to the environment.
